newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Angel Estrada to issue $20 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Angel Estrada to issue $20 mln bond.

text.p: Argentine publishing company Angel Estrada y Compania SA said Thursday it will auction $20 million in negotiable bonds.
The bonds will have a maturity of 18 months and carry a fixed coupon of 11 percent, paid every six months.
The bonds will amortize after six months and at maturity. Angel Estrada said no issue data was fixed but the issue will be placed within six months.
Citicorp Capital Markets SA will underwrite the bond which will be listed on the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange and the Luxembourg Stock Exchange.
The issue is part of the firm's $30 million short- and medium-term non-convertible bond program approved at the end of August.
